From a full machine to a single part

Some jobs are a complete machine. Some are one part. We take on both.

Big builds

Machines and plant equipment for mines and industry

Large fabrication work, built and assembled in our own workshop to your drawings and specifications.

  • Machines and machine frames
  • Chutes, hoppers and tanks
  • Kilns and conveyor-belt modules
  • Crane gantries and roof trusses
  • Carbon and stainless platework, 3 to 40 mm

Smaller jobs

One-off parts, repairs and short runs

If it’s a single part or a quick fix, ask anyway. Small work gets the same care as the big builds.

  • Dropbox, differential and final-drive repairs
  • Pipework and fittings
  • Flanging, threading and reducers
  • T- and Y-pieces and lobster-back bends
  • Staircases and cat ladders

Built in our own workshop

Everything we make is fabricated and assembled at 16 Grader Road, Spartan, Kempton Park, by our own crew.

Engineering behind the build

Send us finished drawings, or bring us the problem first. Our engineering side covers the thinking that comes before the steel is cut.

  • Metallurgical engineering consulting
  • Mechanical engineering consulting
  • Troubleshooting
  • Structural engineering assessments

How a job starts

We build for mines and plants directly, and as the workshop behind engineering firms and contractors who need their designs built.

  1. 1

    Send us the job

    A drawing, a sketch, a photo, or just a description of what you need.

  2. 2

    We look at it

    We tell you whether we can build it and how we would go about it.

  3. 3

    You get a quote

    Priced for your job, not from a catalogue.

  4. 4

    We build it

    In our workshop in Spartan, Kempton Park.

Can we build it? Ask us.

Tell us what you need. Big or small, we’ll let you know if it’s a job for us.
